scope: Bounded engineering attribution; not a novelty claim or external-baseline closure
selection: Human selected current P: PAR_STRONG / FULL / TILED

hardware.isolation: whole-phase inherited locks; pre/during/post foreign-PID checks; owned process groups only

shape.dtype: FP32 input; ordered RN FP64 subtract/multiply/add; RN sqrt to FP32 field

modes.P0: exact current-P source; one range leaf / 256-thread CTA
modes.P1: one range leaf / 32-thread CTA; launch only
modes.P2: three canonical range-list entries / 32-thread CTA; ten lanes per leaf, stride ten; inactive entries not compacted

invariants: logical occurrence IDs and complete outputs

unit.oracle: CPU ordered FP64 with dyadic high-entropy inputs; exact hit and field bits

qualification: 3 bounded mixed workflow full CPU oracle
3 target mixed workflow bound qualified native-rank reference and exact-bit outputs

process_budget.ncu_probe: one diagnostic unit process; no permission escalation

gate_E: all correctness/sanitizers pass; work sidecars bit-identical; actual NSYS grid equals ceil(total canonical leaves/3); P2 leaf inclusive duration below P1 in both reverse profiler rounds; NCU unsupported metrics remain unavailable

primary.timer: summary.trace_ms for complete measured native.trace (336 events)
primary.included: serialized logical request ACKs, input vector uploads, query allocations/launch/synchronization, complete host-ready IDs/fields, updates, compaction/rebuild/refit/refresh, final drain
primary.excluded: cold initial setup/build, separate real 19-event warmup, oracle, counters, profiler, file output
primary.estimator: process-paired geometric P0/P1, P1/P2, P0/P2 ratios
primary.acceptance: P1/P2 CI lower > 1 and at least 5/6 process wins; no independent FULL-kNN claim
primary.secondary: ACK p10/median/p90 by operation; process total by range/knn/update; order strata; marginal median ratios

stop: first runtime, isolation, source, correctness, sanitizer or attribution failure; preserve failed attempt; do not proceed to formal after Gate E failure
limitations: not Safe-C1, not legacy archive, not original GTS
no D96 or K1/K32 claim for this modern P contract
full N1M sanitizer not admitted; bounded actual workflow and exhaustive real leaf unit only
shared inherited full-program leak not resolved here
no all-GPU-tree, new pruning, query-layout, instruction/traffic or occupancy claim without direct evidence

publication_view.kind: UUID-redacted view; measurement contract preserved privately
publication_view.unchanged: workload, variants, timers, budgets, gates and acceptance rules
